name: Rowena Thorne

goals.text: find a liege more worthy of their sword

memories: The sickness came to Redsands, and the people are looking to me.
The Pestilence of Redsands: In the alehouses of Redsands they say Martin brought the sickness. Someone has chalked a mark on his door.
I stood between the people of Redsands and Martin.
The Pestilence of Redsands: The sickness burns itself out. Nobody in Redsands mentions Martin again, and people bless Rowena Thorne's name in the septs.
